mintAuthority.summary: sUSDe is Ethena's savings wrapper over USDe. Ethereum wrapper shares are created against deposited USDe; durable parent issuance remains inherited from usde-ethena. Satellite representation minting and transfer controls belong to bridgeRouteRisk.

controls.label: Ethereum sUSDe staking wrapper
controls.capDescription: Wrapper/share accounting over deposited USDe; does not mint base USDe.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095796, asset() returned USDe 0x4c9edd5852cd905f086c759e8383e09bff1e68b3; the canonical EIP-1967 implementation, admin and beacon slots were zero. The verified deployed StakedUSDeV2 source has no upgrade entry point. owner() returned 0xe8dc0fab349ea169283c48ccfd09d797e6db7c94; its getMinDelay() returned 86400 seconds. The owner contract supports whitelisted-function delay bypass, so the minimum delay is not a universal delay guarantee. Ordinary shares mint against deposited USDe; restricted-holder redistribution burns existing shares before reissuing them, without creating unbacked shares.

review.evidence: Pinned Ethereum block 26095796 confirms USDe as asset(), zero canonical EIP-1967 implementation/admin/beacon slots and owner 0xe8dc0fab349ea169283c48ccfd09d797e6db7c94. Verified StakedUSDeV2 and StakedUSDe source corroborates direct non-proxy share accounting, deposits against USDe, and restricted-holder redistribution of existing shares. The owner's getMinDelay() is 86400 seconds, but its verified source includes whitelisted-function bypass. Native parent issuance remains inherited from usde-ethena; satellite bridge controls are separate.
